title: MyProject3 Core Contract Catalogue
description: Design proposal for stable IDs and cross-domain contracts. Not yet a runtime data file; do not load directly as gameplay configuration without implementation review.
contract_rules: Definition IDs are stable and separate from display labels.
Persistent instance IDs do not change on pickup/place/save.
A failed operation makes no partial authoritative mutation.
Committed events are emitted only after a successful state change.
A shared event/identity/ledger subsystem does not become a duplicate domain-state owner.
Physical large pieces and stackable inventory resources use explicit, mutually exclusive ownership.
Processing state, geometry, construction links, and inventory ownership are related but separate state dimensions.
Preview and commit use the same solved placement result.
Save/load references stable IDs and versions, not transient actor names or array indices.
VFX/audio/animation are feedback, never the authority for success.

required_evidence.static_review: per mechanic and exact code path
required_evidence.automated_test: valid, invalid, idempotent retry and rollback cases where applicable
required_evidence.persistence_test: save, load, cross-reference validation and migration case where required
